## Task: Decompose 5 large inductive proofs in psi_descent.v into smaller per-case lemmas

### Problem
`psi_descent.v` takes 10+ hours and 200+ GB RAM to compile because 5 large proofs (~150 lines each) generate massive proof terms. The `.vo` serialization of these terms causes the memory explosion.

### Solution
Extract each case branch of the 5 big proofs into separate helper lemmas with their own `Qed`. This reduces the proof term size because:
- Each branch lemma has a small proof term
- The parent proof's term becomes just 3 lemma applications
- The kernel doesn't carry all branches simultaneously

### The 5 proofs to decompose

All 5 follow the SAME pattern:
```coq
Lemma foo i w : ... 
Proof.
move: i w.
suff Hgen : forall n i w, size w <= n -> ...
  by move=> *; apply: (Hgen (size w)); rewrite ?leqnn.
elim=> [|n IH] {}i {}w Hsz ...
  (* base case: trivial *)
case: w Hsz ... => [//|a s0] Hsz ...
set s := a :: s0. set j := mm_pos s.
(* common setup *)
case: (ltngtP i j) => [Hij | Hji | Heq_ij].
- (* branch i < j: ~30-50 lines, calls IH recursively *)
- (* branch i > j: ~30-50 lines, calls IH recursively *)
- (* branch i = j: ~10-40 lines *)
Qed.
```

The 5 proofs are:
1. `post_window_extremum` (lines ~153-302)
2. `pre_window_lt_max_when_min_head` (lines ~325-421)
3. `pre_window_gt_min_when_max_head` (lines ~430-522)
4. `exactly_one_descent_LR` (lines ~541-673)
5. `pre_window_extremum_R` (lines ~703-856)

### How to decompose

For each proof, extract the three case branches as separate lemmas. The branch lemmas should take the induction hypothesis `IH` as a parameter. Example structure:

```coq
(* Branch lemma for i < j case *)
Lemma post_window_extremum_lt n
  (IH : forall i w, size w <= n -> uniq w -> 
    i + window_size i w < size w -> CONCLUSION)
  i a s0
  (Hsz : size s0 <= n) (Hu : uniq (a :: s0))
  (Hpost : i + window_size i (a :: s0) < size (a :: s0))
  (Hij : i < mm_pos (a :: s0)) :
  CONCLUSION_for_a_s0.
Proof.
(* The proof body from the i < j branch, verbatim *)
Qed.

(* Similarly for _gt and _eq branches *)

(* Then the main lemma becomes small: *)
Lemma post_window_extremum i w : ...
Proof.
... elim=> [|n IH] ...
case: (ltngtP i j) => [Hij | Hji | Heq_ij].
- exact: post_window_extremum_lt IH _ _ Hsz Hu Hpost Hij.
- exact: post_window_extremum_gt IH _ _ Hsz Hu Hpost Hji.  
- exact: post_window_extremum_eq ...
Qed.
```

### Important constraints
- File: `/scratch/lelarge/mathcomp-eulerian/psi_descent.v`
- Dependencies: `mmtree`, `psi_core`, `psi_comm` (already compiled, .vo files exist)
- MathComp/SSReflect style
- The branch lemma statements need to exactly match what the case split produces
- Use `rocq compile -vos` for quick validation (skips proof checking)
- Then try `rocq compile` for full compilation

### Strategy
1. Read the current `psi_descent.v` carefully
2. Start with the SMALLEST proof first (e.g., `pre_window_gt_min_when_max_head`, ~92 lines) to establish the pattern
3. Validate with `-vos` after each decomposition
4. Apply the same pattern to all 5 proofs
5. Try full compilation to verify and check memory

### Key files
- Target: `psi_descent.v`
- Dependencies already compiled: `mmtree.vo`, `psi_core.vo`, `psi_comm.vo` (in the project root)

### Notes
- The branch lemmas should be `Local` so they don't pollute the namespace
- The `Opaque` declarations already in the file can be kept
- Keep `has_left_child_cons` with its `abstract` proof (already optimized)
- The goal is to reduce `.vo` serialization cost, so each `Qed` should have a small proof term

1	(* psi_descent.v — Milestone 4: Descent-set effect of psi                   *)
2	(* Refactored: has_left_child_cons uses well-founded recursion equation      *)
3	(* to produce small proof terms, avoiding 150+ GB compilation blowup.       *)
4	
5	From mathcomp Require Import all_ssreflect.
6	Require Import mmtree psi_core psi_comm.
7	
8	Set Implicit Arguments.
9	Unset Strict Implicit.
10	Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.
11	
12	(* ===== Milestone 4: Descent-set effect of psi ============================== *)
13	(* Reference: M4_DESCENT_EFFECT_INFORMAL.md (informal proof note).             *)
14	(* Stanley EC1 (2nd ed.) section 1.6.3, Fact #2: how psi_i changes the        *)
15	(* descent set of w.                                                           *)
16	
17	(* ----- M4.0 Descent predicate for seq nat --------------------------------- *)
18	
19	Definition is_descent_seq (w : seq nat) (k : nat) : bool :=
20	  nth 0 w k > nth 0 w k.+1.
21	
22	Example is_descent_seq_ex :
23	  let w := [:: 3; 1; 4; 7; 5; 9; 2; 6] in
24	  [seq k <- iota 0 7 | is_descent_seq w k] = [:: 0; 3; 5].
25	Proof. by []. Qed.
26	
27	(* ----- M4.1 Tree classifier: has_left_child -------------------------------- *)
28	(* Vertex i has a left child iff i > 0 at its recursive level, i.e.,          *)
29	(* mm_pos of the containing subarray is strictly to the right of the          *)
30	(* subarray's left boundary. Mirrors window_size_fuel's recursion.            *)
31	
32	(* -- Fuel-based definition (kept for backward compatibility with             *)
33	(*    psi_cdindex.v which uses has_left_child_fuel directly)                  *)
34	
35	Fixpoint has_left_child_fuel (fuel : nat) (i : nat) (s : seq nat) : bool :=
36	  match fuel with
37	  | 0 => false
38	  | fuel'.+1 =>
39	      match s with
40	      | [::] => false
41	      | _ :: _ =>
42	          let j := mm_pos s in
43	          if i < j then has_left_child_fuel fuel' i (take j s)
44	          else if i == j then (0 < j)
45	          else has_left_child_fuel fuel' (i - j - 1) (drop j.+1 s)
46	      end
47	  end.
48	
49	Definition has_left_child (i : nat) (w : seq nat) : bool :=
50	  has_left_child_fuel (size w) i w.
51	
52	(* -- Core lemmas ----------------------------------------------------------- *)
53	
54	Lemma has_left_child_fuel_0 : forall fuel s,
55	  has_left_child_fuel fuel 0 s = false.
56	Proof.
57	elim=> [//|fuel IH] [//|a s0].
58	by simpl; case: ifP => Hlt; [apply: IH | case: ifP].
59	Qed.
60	
61	Lemma has_left_child_0 s : has_left_child 0 s = false.
62	Proof. exact: has_left_child_fuel_0. Qed.
63	
64	(* Fuel monotonicity — kept for psi_cdindex.v backward compat *)
65	Lemma has_left_child_fuel_monotone fuel1 fuel2 i s :
66	  size s <= fuel1 -> fuel1 <= fuel2 ->
67	  has_left_child_fuel fuel2 i s = has_left_child_fuel fuel1 i s.
68	Proof.
69	elim: fuel1 fuel2 i s => [| f1 IH] f2 i s Hsz1 Hle.
70	  move: Hsz1; rewrite leqn0 => /nilP ->.
71	  by case: f2 Hle.
72	case: f2 Hle => // f2 Hle.
73	case: s Hsz1 => [// | a s0 Hsz1] /=.
74	set s := a :: s0.
75	have Hj : mm_pos s < size s by apply: mm_pos_lt.
76	set j := mm_pos s.
77	have Hj2 : j <= size s0 by rewrite -ltnS.
78	have Htake_sz : size (take j s) <= f1.
79	  rewrite size_take Hj.
80	  by apply: (leq_trans Hj2); rewrite -ltnS.
81	have Hdrop_sz : size (drop j s0) <= f1.
82	  rewrite size_drop.
83	  by apply: (leq_trans (leq_subr _ _)); rewrite -ltnS.
84	have Hle1 : f1 <= f2 by [].
85	case: ifP => _.
86	  by apply: IH.
87	case: ifP => _ //.
88	by apply: IH.
89	Qed.
90	
91	(* -- has_left_child_cons: THE KEY LEMMA ------------------------------------ *)
92	(* abstract wraps each fuel_monotone application in an opaque sub-lemma,     *)
93	(* preventing the kernel from inlining the proof term into downstream Qeds.  *)
94	
95	Lemma has_left_child_cons i a s0 :
96	  let s := a :: s0 in
97	  let j := mm_pos s in
98	  has_left_child i s =
99	    if i < j then has_left_child i (take j s)
100	    else if i == j then (0 < j)

100	    else if i == j then (0 < j)
101	    else has_left_child (i - j - 1) (drop j.+1 s).
102	Proof.
103	set s := a :: s0. set j := mm_pos s.
104	have Hj : j < size s by apply: mm_pos_lt.
105	have Hj2 : j <= size s0 by rewrite -ltnS.
106	have Htake_sz : size (take j s) <= size s0.
107	  by rewrite size_take Hj.
108	have Hdrop_sz : size (drop j s0) <= size s0.
109	  by rewrite size_drop; apply: leq_subr.
110	rewrite /has_left_child /= -/j.
111	case: ifP => _.
112	  abstract (apply: has_left_child_fuel_monotone => //).
113	case: ifP => _ //.
114	abstract (apply: has_left_child_fuel_monotone => //).
115	Qed.
116	
117	(* Vertex 2 (value 4) in [3;1;4;7;5;9;2;6]: subarray [4;7;5], mm_pos=0,
118	   left subtree empty => no left child. *)
119	Example has_left_child_false :
120	  has_left_child 2 [:: 3; 1; 4; 7; 5; 9; 2; 6] = false.
121	Proof. by []. Qed.
122	
123	(* Vertex 5 (value 9): subarray [4;7;5;9;2;6], mm_pos=3 (relative),
124	   left subtree [4;7;5] nonempty => has left child. *)
125	Example has_left_child_true :
126	  has_left_child 5 [:: 3; 1; 4; 7; 5; 9; 2; 6] = true.
127	Proof. by []. Qed.
128	
129	(* Non-triviality: L = [4;7;5], head=4=min, p=1, q=2.
130	   nth 0 L 1 = 7, nth 0 L 2 = 5: 7 > 5 = true.
131	   rank_shift_seq [4;7;5] = [7;5;4]: nth 0 _ 1 = 5, nth 0 _ 2 = 4: 5 > 4 = true. *)
132	Example rank_shift_interior_order_ex :
133	  let L := [:: 4; 7; 5] in
134	  (nth 0 L 1 > nth 0 L 2) = (nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) 1 > nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) 2).
135	Proof. by []. Qed.
136	
137	(* ----- M4.4 Window head is extremum --------------------------------------- *)
138	(* Proved as Lemma window_head_extremum in the T6 section above.             *)
139	(* The Axiom window_head_is_extremum has been retired.                       *)
140	
141	(* ----- M4.5 Boundary lemmas ----------------------------------------------- *)
142	(* The element just after the window is an ancestor's extremum, hence either  *)
143	(* less than min(window) or greater than max(window). Since rank_shift only  *)
144	(* permutes the window values, the descent bit at the right boundary is      *)
145	(* unchanged.                                                                *)
146	(* Justification: M4_DESCENT_EFFECT_INFORMAL.md section 2 (Case 4).          *)
147	
148	Lemma post_window_extremum i w :
149	  uniq w -> i + window_size i w < size w ->
150	  (nth 0 w (i + window_size i w) < nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w)) 0) \/
151	  (nth 0 w (i + window_size i w) > nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w))
152	                                        (window_size i w).-1).
153	Proof.
154	move: i w.
155	suff Hgen : forall n i w, size w <= n ->
156	  uniq w -> i + window_size i w < size w ->
157	  (nth 0 w (i + window_size i w)
158	     < nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w)) 0) \/
159	  (nth 0 w (i + window_size i w)
160	     > nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w))
161	             (window_size i w).-1).
162	  by move=> i w Hu Hws; apply: (Hgen (size w));
163	     rewrite ?leqnn.
164	elim=> [|n IH] i w Hsz Huniq Hpost.
165	  by rewrite leqn0 in Hsz; move/eqP: Hsz Hpost => -> /=.
166	case: w Hsz Huniq Hpost => [//|a s0] Hsz Huniq Hpost.
167	set s := a :: s0; set j := mm_pos s.
168	have Hj : j < size s by apply: mm_pos_lt.
169	have Hs_ne : s <> [::] by discriminate.
170	rewrite (window_at_cons i a s0) (window_size_cons i a s0)
171	  -/s -/j.
172	case: (ltngtP i j) => [Hij | Hji | Heq_ij].
173	- (* Case i < j *)
174	  have Hfit := window_fits_left Hs_ne Hij.
175	  (* ws in take j s = ws in s (by window_size_cons) *)
176	  set ws_t := window_size i (take j s).
177	  have Hws_eq : window_size i s = ws_t
178	    by rewrite (window_size_cons i a s0) -/j Hij.
179	  have Htake_sz : size (take j s) = j
180	    by rewrite size_take Hj.
181	  have Huniq_t : uniq (take j s).
182	    have : uniq (take j s ++ drop j s)
183	      by rewrite cat_take_drop.
184	    by rewrite cat_uniq => /andP [? _].
185	  case Hbnd : (i + ws_t < j).
186	  + (* Sub-case: i + ws < j, both in take j s *)
187	    have Hpost_t : i + ws_t < size (take j s)
188	      by rewrite Htake_sz.
189	    have Hsz_t : size (take j s) <= n.
190	      by rewrite Htake_sz -ltnS;
191	         exact: leq_trans Hj Hsz.
192	    have := IH i (take j s) Hsz_t Huniq_t Hpost_t.
193	    (* nth in take j s = nth in s *)
194	    by rewrite nth_take.
195	  + (* Sub-case: i + ws = j *)
196	    have Hfit2 : i + ws_t = j.
197	      move/negbT: Hbnd; rewrite -leqNgt => Hge.
198	      have : i + window_size i s <= j := Hfit.
199	      by rewrite Hws_eq => Hfit';
200	         apply/eqP; rewrite eqn_leq Hge Hfit'.
201	    rewrite Hfit2.
202	    have Hnth_j := nth_w_mm_pos Hs_ne.
203	    (* Window values are in take j s *)
204	    set wa := window_at i (take j s).
205	    have Hws_t_gt0 : 0 < ws_t.
206	      by apply: window_size_gt0; rewrite Htake_sz.
207	    have Hwa_sz : size wa = ws_t.
208	      rewrite /wa /window_at.
209	      apply: size_takel.
210	      have := window_size_bound i (take j s).
211	      by rewrite size_drop Htake_sz.
212	    have Hwa_ne : wa <> [::].
213	      by move=> Habs; rewrite Habs /= in Hwa_sz;
214	         move: Hws_t_gt0; rewrite -Hwa_sz.
215	    (* All wa elements are in take j s *)
216	    have Hwa_sub : {subset wa <= take j s}.
217	      move=> x; rewrite /wa /window_at => Hx.
218	      have H1 := mem_take Hx.
219	      exact: mem_drop H1.
220	    (* min(s) and max(s) *)
221	    set minv := foldr minn (head 0 s) (behead s).
222	    set maxv := foldr maxn (head 0 s) (behead s).
223	    have [Hno_min Hno_max] := notin_take_mm Hs_ne.
224	    (* min(wa) >= min(s) and max(wa) <= max(s) *)
225	    have Hmin_sort := min_eq_nth_sort_0 Hwa_ne.
226	    have Hmax_sort := max_eq_nth_sort_last Hwa_ne.
227	    case: Hnth_j => Hval.
228	    * (* nth 0 s j = minv: show minv < min(wa) *)
229	      left; rewrite Hval.
230	      rewrite -Hmin_sort.
231	      set minwa := foldr minn (head 0 wa) (behead wa).
232	      have Hminwa_in : minwa \in wa.
233	        rewrite /minwa; case: (wa) Hwa_ne => [//|b t] _ /=.
234	        exact: min_in.
235	      have Hminwa_le : minv <= minwa.
236	        apply: foldr_minn_le.
237	        have := Hwa_sub _ Hminwa_in.
238	        exact: mem_take.
239	      have Hminwa_ne : minv != minwa.
240	        apply/negP => /eqP Heq_v.
241	        have : minv \in take j s
242	          by rewrite Heq_v; apply: Hwa_sub.
243	        by rewrite (negbTE Hno_min).
244	      by rewrite ltn_neqAle Hminwa_ne Hminwa_le.
245	    * (* nth 0 s j = maxv: show maxv > max(wa) *)
246	      right; rewrite Hval -Hwa_sz -Hmax_sort.
247	      set maxwa := foldr maxn (head 0 wa) (behead wa).
248	      have Hmaxwa_in : maxwa \in wa.
249	        rewrite /maxwa; case: (wa) Hwa_ne => [//|b t] _ /=.

250	        exact: max_in.
251	      have Hmaxwa_le : maxwa <= maxv.
252	        apply: foldr_maxn_ge.
253	        have := Hwa_sub _ Hmaxwa_in.
254	        exact: mem_take.
255	      have Hmaxwa_ne : maxwa != maxv.
256	        apply/negP => /eqP Heq_v.
257	        have : maxv \in take j s
258	          by rewrite -Heq_v; apply: Hwa_sub.
259	        by rewrite (negbTE Hno_max).
260	      by rewrite ltn_neqAle Hmaxwa_ne Hmaxwa_le.
261	- (* Case i > j: recurse on drop j.+1 s *)
262	  set i' := i - j - 1.
263	  set ds := drop j.+1 s.
264	  have Hds_sz : size ds = size s - j.+1
265	    by rewrite size_drop.
266	  have Huniq_d : uniq ds.
267	    have : uniq (take j.+1 s ++ drop j.+1 s)
268	      by rewrite cat_take_drop.
269	    by rewrite cat_uniq => /andP [_ /andP [_ ?]].
270	  have Hi'_eq : i' + j.+1 = i.
271	    by rewrite /i' -subnDA addn1 subnK.
272	  have Hws_eq : window_size i s = window_size i' ds.
273	    by rewrite (window_size_cons i a s0) -/j
274	       (ltnNge i j) (ltnW Hji) /= eq_sym (ltn_eqF Hji).
275	  have Hpost' : i + window_size i s < size s := Hpost.
276	  have Hpost_d : i' + window_size i' ds < size ds.
277	    suff : i' + window_size i' ds + j.+1 < size ds + j.+1.
278	      by rewrite ltn_add2r.
279	    rewrite Hds_sz subnK; last exact: Hj.
280	    rewrite -Hws_eq /i' -subnDA addn1.
281	    by rewrite addnAC subnK.
282	  have Hsz0 : size s0 <= n by exact: Hsz.
283	  have Hsz_d : size ds <= n.
284	    rewrite Hds_sz /s /= subSS.
285	    exact: leq_trans (leq_subr j _) Hsz0.
286	  have := IH i' ds Hsz_d Huniq_d Hpost_d.
287	  set ws' := window_size i' ds.
288	  have Hnth_eq : nth 0 s (i + ws') =
289	                 nth 0 ds (i' + ws').
290	    rewrite /ds nth_drop addnA
291	      [j.+1 + i']addnC Hi'_eq.
292	    by [].
293	  by rewrite Hnth_eq.
294	- (* Case i = j: vacuous *)
295	  subst i.
296	  exfalso.
297	  have Hws_j : window_size j s = size s - j.
298	    by rewrite (window_size_cons j a s0) -/j ltnn eqxx.
299	  move: Hpost; rewrite -/s Hws_j addnC subnK;
300	    last exact: ltnW.
301	  by rewrite ltnn.
302	Qed.
303	#[global] Opaque post_window_extremum.
304	
305	(* Non-triviality: w = [3;1;4;7;5;9;2;6], i=2. Window = [4;7;5] at [2,5).
306	   Post-window element at position 5: w[5] = 9. max(window) = 7.
307	   9 > 7 = true: post-window element is > max(window). *)
308	Example post_window_extremum_ex :
309	  let w := [:: 3; 1; 4; 7; 5; 9; 2; 6] in
310	  nth 0 w (2 + window_size 2 w) > nth 0 (sort leq (window_at 2 w)) (window_size 2 w).-1.
311	Proof. by []. Qed.
312	
313	(* ----- M4.6 Pre-window lemmas (Case LR) ----------------------------------- *)
314	(* When vertex i has both children and head = min, the max of the subarray   *)
315	(* is in the right subtree, so max(window) = max(subarray) > w[i-1].        *)
316	(* Symmetrically when head = max, min(window) = min(subarray) < w[i-1].     *)
317	(* Justification: M4_DESCENT_EFFECT_INFORMAL.md section 4.                   *)
318	
319	Lemma pre_window_lt_max_when_min_head :
320	  forall (i : nat) (w : seq nat),
321	  uniq w -> 0 < i -> has_left_child i w ->
322	  1 < window_size i w ->
323	  head 0 (window_at i w) == nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w)) 0 ->
324	  nth 0 w i.-1 <
325	    nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w)) (window_size i w).-1.
326	Proof.
327	move=> i w.
328	suff Hgen : forall n i w, size w <= n ->
329	  uniq w -> 0 < i -> has_left_child i w ->
330	  1 < window_size i w ->
331	  head 0 (window_at i w) ==
332	    nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w)) 0 ->
333	  nth 0 w i.-1 <
334	    nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w))
335	          (window_size i w).-1.
336	  by move=> *; apply: (Hgen (size w)); rewrite ?leqnn.
337	elim=> [|n IH] {}i {}w Hsz Huniq Hi0 Hlc Hws Hhead.
338	  have /eqP Hw0 : size w == 0 by rewrite -leqn0.
339	  by move: Hws; move/size0nil: Hw0 => ->;
340	     rewrite /window_size /=.
341	case: w Hsz Huniq Hlc Hws Hhead => [//|a s0]
342	  Hsz Huniq Hlc Hws Hhead.
343	set s := a :: s0; set j := mm_pos s.
344	have Hj : j < size s by apply: mm_pos_lt.
345	have Hs_ne : s <> [::] by discriminate.
346	rewrite (window_at_cons i a s0) (window_size_cons i a s0)
347	  -/s -/j.
348	rewrite (has_left_child_cons i a s0) -/s -/j in Hlc.
349	rewrite (window_at_cons i a s0) (window_size_cons i a s0)
350	  -/s -/j in Hhead Hws.
351	case: (ltngtP i j) => [Hij | Hji | Heq_ij].
352	- (* i < j: recurse on take j s *)
353	  move: Hhead Hlc Hws; rewrite Hij => Hhead Hlc Hws.
354	  have Huniq_t : uniq (take j s).
355	    by have : uniq (take j s ++ drop j s);
356	       [rewrite cat_take_drop | rewrite cat_uniq => /andP[]].
357	  have Hsz_t : size (take j s) <= n.
358	    by rewrite size_take Hj; exact: leq_trans Hj Hsz.
359	  have := IH _ _ Hsz_t Huniq_t Hi0 Hlc Hws Hhead.
360	  have Hpred_lt : i.-1 < j.
361	    by apply: leq_ltn_trans (leq_pred _) Hij.
362	  by rewrite nth_take.
363	- (* i > j: recurse on drop j.+1 s *)
364	  have Hij_f : i < j = false by rewrite ltnNge (ltnW Hji).
365	  have Heq_f : (i == j) = false
366	    by apply: gtn_eqF.
367	  move: Hhead Hlc Hws; rewrite Hij_f Heq_f =>
368	    Hhead Hlc Hws.
369	  set i' := i - j - 1.
370	  set ds := drop j.+1 s.
371	  have Huniq_d : uniq ds.
372	    by have : uniq (take j.+1 s ++ drop j.+1 s);
